name: Hand fix designs
ownerWords:
look, YOUR JOB IS TO MAKE SURE THE SOFTWARE IS DURABLE. 자체적으로 고쳐질 수 있게 설계를 바꾸는게 니 역할이야

문제를 고치는게 아니라 소프트웨어 엔지니어야 너는
goal: Every hand fix on prod or staging (a config write, a hand-started process, a thaw, a re-queue, a CI cancel or rerun) maps to a known fault with a live design job, and a fault whose design shipped needs no more hand fixes. No prod or staging writer runs by hand in an agent session or a docker exec. A source this check cannot read counts as a miss.

metrics.label: Open faults with no design job
Hand fixes in 24 h for a fault whose design already shipped
Hand fixes in 24 h that match no fault in the design list
Prod or staging writers run by hand, outside a supervised service

onMiss: Each missed metric gets exactly one live fix job, with a board step under p96 whose text starts "d3/<metric key>:" and names the cause with the flagged numbers. faults_without_job: design each listed fault and add its step to the fault's designs in hand-fixes.faults.json. undesigned_hand_fixes: add its fault to that file with design refs and a design job (c63). repeats_after_design: reopen its design step with the evidence and message its job. hand_run_processes: move each flagged process into a supervised service. A live job that owns the cause (agent_observe.list_agents()) gets the new numbers by message. If none is live, start one with await rlm.create_session(brief, name=..., cwd=...) and set the step's job to it. Never start a second copy. The brief names metric, value, target and cause, and asks for shipped code until green. Never end a run with a miss and no live fix job. Prod promotes need no ask (c74). Nothing goes outside (c37). All on target: end the turn with no message.
